description: Synthetic referral notes with the value a correct extractor should propose. null means the extractor should leave the field for the clinician (missing, ambiguous, negated, conflicting or out of a convertible form). All notes are invented; no patient data. n01-n30 were written alongside the rule-based extractor, so its score there is optimistic; n31-n40 vary the phrasing and were labelled before running any extractor.
